name: Banh it la gai
summary: Bánh ít lá gai, as ZaloPay describes it, is a small cake in banana leaf: a black dough of pounded ramie leaf and sticky rice, with mung bean or coconut. It names the cake for Tết, weddings, and offerings.
howToEat: ZaloPay: wrapped in green banana leaf, black skin from pounded ramie leaf mixed with sticky rice, filling of mung bean or coconut. Eaten at Tết and weddings, and offered to ancestors.
No street, no hour, and no price were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh it la gai in Quang Ngai
seoDescription: Bánh ít lá gai in banana leaf, ramie leaf and sticky rice, mung bean or coconut, as ZaloPay describes it. Price and hour are Check on arrival.
